name: MonsiTools Calculation API
description: Send a calculator's inputs, get its result back as JSON. Premium accounts, 60 requests per minute. Authenticate with an API key from Dashboard > API access (Authorization: Bearer mt_live_...). Tools and their input ids: /api-tools.json. Every call made with your account is counted in its usage, shown on the dashboard.
